files.Main.cs: IIncrementalGenerator implementation - scans for MapAttribute, ExtendAttribute
files.Mappers.cs: Orchestration layer - manages TypeSet, TypeMap creation, source emission
files.TypeMap.cs: Core mapping logic (1250 lines) - member matching, collections, scalar conversions, recursive types
files.TypeMeta.cs: Type metadata - extracts members, detects collections, builds UnsafeAccessor code
files.TypeSet.cs: Type cache/registry - deduplication, method name sanitization
files.MemberMeta.cs: Member representation - property/field with Matches() method, nullability
files.MapAttribute.cs: All attributes: MapAttribute, IgnoreAttribute, IgnoreForAttribute, MaxAttribute, ExtendAttribute, IImplement
files.Constants.cs: Enums: ApplyTo, EnumerableType, MappingKind (Normal=1, Fill=2, All=3)
files.Helpers.cs: Utilities: string manipulation, type helpers (IsPrimitive, IsNullable, InheritsOrImplements), hash computation
files.Helpers/Map.cs: Custom hash table<TKey, TValue> - optimized, no LINQ
files.Helpers/Set.cs: Custom hash set<TKey, TValue> - optimized, no LINQ

files.BindAttribute.cs: Attributes: BindAttribute, IgnoreBindAttribute, MaxAttribute, ExtendAttribute, IImplement
files.TypeMappingEntry.cs: Core bidirectional mapping definition with method names, collection info
files.TypeMetadata.cs: Type metadata - member extraction, collection info, enum extension generation
files.MappingSet/MappingSet.cs: Main orchestration - custom hash dictionary for TypeMapping storage
files.MappingSet/MappingSet.TypeSet.cs: TypeSet - type cache with custom hash dictionary
files.MappingSet/MappingSet.ParseTypesMap.cs: Recursive type traversal, scalar conversion detection, KeyValuePair mapping
files.MappingSet/MappingSet.MemberHelpers.cs: BuildMemberMapping - individual member assignment, UnsafeAccessor emission
files.MappingSet/MappingSet.ValueHelpers.cs: GetNullability, GenerateValue - nullability computation and value emission

files.Test.cs: Main test - UserDto <-> User roundtrip mapping
files.UserDto.cs: DTO with tuple for MainRole, Dictionary for ExtendedProperties

commands.build-test: dotnet build SourceCrafter.MappingGenerator.slnx -c Debug && dotnet test SourceCrafter.MappingGenerator.UnitTests/SourceCrafter.MappingGenerator.UnitTests.csproj -c Release --no-build

configurations.DebugSGen: Debug with Debugger.Launch() at generator start

patterns.addingNewMapping: Add [assembly: Map<Source, Target>] in any .cs file or [Map<Source>] on target class
patterns.ignoreMember: Use [Ignore] attribute to exclude from all mappings
patterns.unsafeAccessor: Automatically used on .NET 8+ for readonly fields and init-only properties

TypeMap.responsibility: Core mapping logic - builds mapper methods for objects, collections, dictionaries. Handles recursive types, scalar conversions, collection mapping

Mappers.responsibility: Top-level orchestration - holds TypeSet, manages TypeMap creation, emits generated source files

GeneratedMappers.responsibility: IIncrementalGenerator entry point - scans for attributes, orchestrates generation

methods.ToTarget: TTarget ToTarget(this TSource source) - creates new target populated from source
methods.Update: TTarget Update(this TTarget target, TSource source) - updates target in-place, returns target
methods.Copy: TSelf Copy(this TSelf source) - deep structural copy of same type
